ev.q: As of November 20, 2003, the investigation had identified 1,069 contacts, 36 (3.4%) of whom reported having a positive tuberculin skin test
Among the 1,033 persons eligible for a TST, 648 (62.7%) received at least one test
Three (43%) patients had cavitary pulmonary disease
56 (8.6%) of these had a positive result
Six (86%) patients had a history of alcoholism.
A total of 163 (15.2%) contacts had chest radiographs
Six were linked through residence at homeless shelters; four had matching Mycobacterium tuberculosis genotypes.
Active TB case-finding for this investigation is ongoing.

methods_quotes.q: M. tuberculosis isolates from all seven patients were genotyped by using spoligotyping, mycobacterial interspersed repetitive units analysis, and IS6110--based restriction fragment length polymorphism analysis.
